emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed leadership handoff within the scorable Technology & AI complex: AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) currently holds rank 2 with weak breadth (0.176) and a mean-revert tag, while Semiconductors (512760.SS) sits at rank 5 with trend tag but absolute-zero breadth. Lean underweight as a stay-out-of-the-way preference given rank-IC ~0 and unscheduled_share 0.97 (news-driven, not trend-driven tape).
evidence: rank 2, score 1.385, eligible true, scorable true (ETF 515000.SS)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus low breadth could mean the theme has already shaken out weak holders and is coiled for a reflexive squeeze higher if policy momentum returns.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS rallies by 8% before the 20-day check-by date on expanding breadth.

theses.thesis: Scorable theme (ETF 159992.SZ) at rank 3 with score 1.14 but crowding_z 1.32 (crowded true) — the only crowded scorable-positive theme. Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade, and with crowding flagged the responsible directional lean on a low-confidence tape is underweight rather than overweight. evidence: guardrails: crowding is size-down only, never a fade

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by 6% before the 20-day check-by date on sustained fund inflows.
